verdict.rationale: Vendor pages mention invoicing as a core feature and describe automation like 'sending bulk collection reminders' and workflow triggers to 'notify' customers, which supports the automatic-reminder half of the story, but there is no explicit documentation of a recurring/auto-generated invoice scheduling feature. missing for 10: explicit recurring invoice setup/scheduling documentation, dedicated overdue-reminder configuration details, and independent/hands-on corroboration of either capability.
